text:
emma: Heads up — Acme Corp POC needs EU + Canada data residency. They also asked for a full sub-processor list and an egress cost delta. Can we assemble a short checklist for the SOW?
chris: quick Q — are they happy with hosted pinning or asking for dedicated?
natalie: they said preferred pinned hosted region, but will consider dedicated if price is close.
emma: they want assurance that customer data won't leave selected regions except control-plane telemetry.
oliver: legal note: control plane metadata may route via us regions for orchestration. Data plane can be pinned to ca-central1 or eu-west1; we must state that in the questionnaire.
chris: confirmed; current sub-processors touching data plane in ca/eu: GCP (data storage & inference), Cloudflare (edge CDN), optional: HashiCorp Vault for BYOK.
natalie: I'll pull the attestation docs. attaching links in thread when ready. ETA EOD.
emma: egress cost question — what multiplier should I quote for routing to ca-central1 vs hosted default?
chris: rough multiplier: 1.18 for ca, 1.12 for eu-west (per-token unit). I'll get precise numbers for the quote.
chris: snippet of config we usually send:
```
routing_policy:
  preferred_regions: [ca-central1, eu-west1]
  fallback: hosted-global
  egress_multiplier: { ca-central1: 1.18, eu-west1: 1.12 }
  kms: BYOK_allowed
```
deploy-bot: Deployment event: pinned-dataplane-ca-central1 provisioning started :gear: (job id 76423)
oliver: For the security questionnaire Q12 "Do you transfer data outside customer region?" answer: "Data plane is pinned to customer region(s); control plane orchestration metadata may traverse other regions. See attestation for details"
emma: Can ops provide the final subproc list + cert URLs and indicate whether any subprocessors have EU-US or CA-US transfers?
natalie: On it. I'll list each subproc with country and transfer status. Will confirm Cloudflare config (edge-only, no logs stored). ETA 1700 UTC.
emma: Perfect. Also the customer asked if we can run a 1% canary to eu-only to measure latency before full cutover. Thoughts?
chris: doable if we route 1% traffic via canary policy — recommend dedicated capacity for SLOs. Without dedicated, 99.9 SLO is risky under bursty load.
emma: Looping in @sam to confirm pricing delta hosted vs dedicated for this pinned CA+EU setup.
sam: Will confirm numbers. Preliminary: hosted routing delta ~= +18% for CA, dedicated setup adds a monthly reserve fee; will post exact broken down quote in the deal room.
emma: Thanks all — I'll aggregate answers into the SOW draft and security response. If anyone has final attestation links, paste here. :thumbsup:
